Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns as Education Minister Amidst Protests

Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post. The resignation occurred amidst ongoing protests, with one report stating Pradhan had offered to resign on the first day of the Jantar Mantar demonstrations. The reasons for his resignation are debated, with some coverage suggesting it was a strategic move by the BJP for larger political goals, potentially influenced by the 'Gen Z' demographic and upcoming election calculations. Another report noted Pradhan had previously resigned twice, with his third offer being accepted.
